name: API Gateway & Live Services
purpose: The FastAPI surface: REST + WebSocket routes, the shared detection hub, the demo telemetry service, bounded live camera workers and the production auth middleware. Owns request lifecycle, worker supervision and the wire format clients consume.

public_interfaces.name: ASGI app (uvicorn src.api.app:app)
public_interfaces.contract: Serves /, /health, /ready, /setup, the /api/v1/* REST surface and the /ws/* streams; demo mode works with no camera and no token.

public_interfaces.name: Telemetry packet contract (demo/live frame endpoints)
public_interfaces.contract: Every packet carries source, frame identity, timestamps, detections, tracks, zones, forecast status and risk; the UI must never need to guess freshness.

public_interfaces.name: LiveService worker supervision
public_interfaces.contract: One bounded worker per camera, no credential leakage into telemetry, stale frames reported as stale.

public_interfaces.name: TokenAuthMiddleware / is_public_showcase
public_interfaces.contract: Production requires SENTINEL_API_TOKEN on non-public routes; demo showcase routes stay open by design.

acceptance_criteria: /health and /ready answer in demo mode with no camera configured.
A production deployment without SENTINEL_API_TOKEN refuses protected routes.
Live workers stop on shutdown and never log credentials.
Every route is covered by at least one test in this project's slice.
risks: app.py is still the module-level integration hub; it both wires subsystems and holds their state, which is why the agentic layer reaches back into it.
Live camera workers are threads inside the web process; a hard camera failure must not take the API down.
